title: ORAN FH CUS: try to fix scan-build warnings
description:
I think the state lookup for every frame has to
succeed for 'visited' case, but explicitly test (other
option was some kind of dissector assert).

Also removed 2-part lookup (lookup32 guarded by contains32).
This would only make sense if 0 was a valid/found entry, but
these are pointers, and analysis tools won't know that the
contains32 call is doomed to succeed.
